result.topic_en: Dated diary entries from July to October 1797 on periods and their signs, counting irreducible (prime) functions modulo p, a divisibility theorem for such functions, congruences to composite moduli, and a proof that equations have imaginary roots.
result.transcription:
# Plani possibilitatem demonstravi. Iul. 28 {+Gotting.+}
Quod Iul. 27 inscripsi errorem involvit: sed eo felicius
nunc rem exhausimus, quoniam probari possumus nullum
periodum esse posse numerum [-fract-] rationalem. Aug. 1
Quomodo periodorum numerum duplicando
signa adornare oporteat
Functionum primarum multitudinem per analysin
simplicissimam erui. Aug. 26
Theorema. Si [-1+a-]x [-+b-]xx + &c.. + mx^μ [?] est functio secundum
modulum p. prima erit
[-1 - b + ax + a-]
$1+x+x^{p}+x^{pp}+ \&c\; x^{p^{\mu-1}}$ [?] per hanc fctnem secundum
hunc modulum divisibilis Aug. 30
&c. &c
Demonstratum, viaque ad multa maiora per introd.
Modulorum multiplicium strata Aug. 31.
Aug. 1. generalius ad quosvis modulos adaptatum
Sept. 4.
# Principia detexi, ad quae congruentiarum secundum
modulos multiplices resolutio ad congruentias secundum
modulum linearem reducitur Sept. 9
# Aequationes habere radices imaginarias
methodo genuina demonstratum. Bruns. Oct.
Prom. in dissert. special. Mense Aug. 1799.

methods.what: Proof that no period can be a rational number
methods.quote:
probari possumus nullum
periodum esse posse numerum [-fract-] rationalem

methods.what: Rule for assigning signs when the number of periods is doubled
methods.quote:
Quomodo periodorum numerum duplicando
signa adornare oporteat

methods.what: Count of irreducible (prime) functions modulo p obtained by a very simple analysis
methods.quote:
Functionum primarum multitudinem per analysin
simplicissimam erui.

methods.what: Theorem: a polynomial of degree μ that is irreducible mod p divides the expression built from x^{p^k} modulo p
methods.quote:
$1+x+x^{p}+x^{pp}+ \&c\; x^{p^{\mu-1}}$ [?] per hanc fctnem secundum
hunc modulum divisibilis

methods.what: Reduction of solving congruences modulo composite (multiple) moduli to congruences modulo a linear modulus
methods.quote:
congruentiarum secundum
modulos multiplices resolutio ad congruentias secundum
modulum linearem reducitur

methods.what: Proof that equations have imaginary roots by a genuine method (fundamental theorem of algebra)
methods.quote:
Aequationes habere radices imaginarias
methodo genuina demonstratum.

items.english: I have proved the possibility of the plan.
What I wrote on July 27 involved an error.

items.quote:
Quomodo periodorum numerum duplicando
signa adornare oporteat
items.english: How the signs ought to be arranged when the number of periods is doubled.

items.quote:
Theorema. Si [-1+a-]x [-+b-]xx + &c.. + mx^μ [?] est functio secundum
modulum p. prima erit
items.english: Theorem. If a + bx + cxx + ... + mx^μ is a prime function with respect to the modulus p, then 1 + x + x^p + x^{pp} + ... x^{p^{μ-1}} will be divisible by this function with respect to this modulus.

items.quote:
Demonstratum, viaque ad multa maiora per introd.
Modulorum multiplicium strata
items.english: Proved, and a way to many greater things paved by introducing multiple moduli.

items.quote: Aug. 1. generalius ad quosvis modulos adaptatum
items.english: The result of Aug. 1 adapted more generally to any moduli.

items.quote:
Principia detexi, ad quae congruentiarum secundum
modulos multiplices resolutio ad congruentias secundum
modulum linearem reducitur
items.english: I discovered the principles by which the solution of congruences with respect to multiple moduli is reduced to congruences with respect to a linear modulus.

items.quote:
Aequationes habere radices imaginarias
methodo genuina demonstratum.
items.english: That equations have imaginary roots has been proved by a genuine method.
